tasks.label: Configure
args: mkdir -p build && echo "${input:coreConfiguration}" > build/.config && echo "Configuration set to: ${input:coreConfiguration}"

tasks.label: Build
args: CONFIG=$(cat build/.config 2>/dev/null) && case "$CONFIG" in he) echo Building HE only... && west build -p auto -b alif_e7_dk/ae722f80f55d5xx/rtss_he project/apps/he_app -d build/he;; hp) echo Building HP only... && west build -p auto -b alif_e7_dk/ae722f80f55d5xx/rtss_hp project/apps/hp_app -d build/hp;; he_hp) echo Building HE and HP... && west build -p auto -b alif_e7_dk/ae722f80f55d5xx/rtss_he project/apps/he_app -d build/he && west build -p auto -b alif_e7_dk/ae722f80f55d5xx/rtss_hp project/apps/hp_app -d build/hp;; he_mcuboot) echo Building HE with MCUboot... && west build -p auto -b alif_e7_dk/ae722f80f55d5xx/rtss_he project/apps/he_app -d build/he --sysbuild;; hp_mcuboot) echo Building HP with MCUboot... && west build -p auto -b alif_e7_dk/ae722f80f55d5xx/rtss_hp project/apps/hp_app -d build/hp --sysbuild;; he_hp_mcuboot) echo Building HE and HP with MCUboot... && west build -p auto -b alif_e7_dk/ae722f80f55d5xx/rtss_he project/apps/he_app -d build/he --sysbuild && west build -p auto -b alif_e7_dk/ae722f80f55d5xx/rtss_hp project/apps/hp_app -d build/hp --sysbuild;; *) echo Error: Unknown configuration && exit 1;; esac

tasks.label: Run tests
args: (cd ${workspaceFolder}/project/apps/he_app/tests && west build -b native_sim --pristine && west build -t run) && (cd ${workspaceFolder}/project/apps/hp_app/tests && west build -b native_sim --pristine && west build -t run)

tasks.label: [subtask] Copy .bin
args: CONFIG=$(cat ${workspaceFolder}/build/.config 2>/dev/null || echo he_hp) && case "$CONFIG" in he) sudo cp -f ${workspaceFolder}/build/he/zephyr/zephyr.bin ./build/images/he_app.bin;; hp) sudo cp -f ${workspaceFolder}/build/hp/zephyr/zephyr.bin ./build/images/hp_app.bin;; he_hp) sudo cp -f ${workspaceFolder}/build/he/zephyr/zephyr.bin ./build/images/he_app.bin && sudo cp -f ${workspaceFolder}/build/hp/zephyr/zephyr.bin ./build/images/hp_app.bin;; he_mcuboot) sudo cp -f ${workspaceFolder}/build/he/mcuboot/zephyr/zephyr.bin ./build/images/he_app_bootloader.bin && sudo cp -f ${workspaceFolder}/build/he/he_app/zephyr/zephyr.signed.bin ./build/images/he_app.signed.bin;; hp_mcuboot) sudo cp -f ${workspaceFolder}/build/hp/mcuboot/zephyr/zephyr.bin ./build/images/hp_app_bootloader.bin && sudo cp -f ${workspaceFolder}/build/hp/hp_app/zephyr/zephyr.signed.bin ./build/images/hp_app.signed.bin;; he_hp_mcuboot) sudo cp -f ${workspaceFolder}/build/he/mcuboot/zephyr/zephyr.bin ./build/images/he_app_bootloader.bin && sudo cp -f ${workspaceFolder}/build/he/he_app/zephyr/zephyr.signed.bin ./build/images/he_app.signed.bin && sudo cp -f ${workspaceFolder}/build/hp/mcuboot/zephyr/zephyr.bin ./build/images/hp_app_bootloader.bin && sudo cp -f ${workspaceFolder}/build/hp/hp_app/zephyr/zephyr.signed.bin ./build/images/hp_app.signed.bin;; *) echo Error: Unknown configuration && exit 1;; esac
